text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stopping by the shopping mall with Durandal,
we spotted a familiar face wearing quite a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, what might you be doing in a place like this?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was figuring out the shortest route for bulk buying.
Right now, I just completed a world record run in my head.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I always tell you to buy consumables regularly, don't I? You bought way too much at once.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Around yesterday, I diluted my shampoo with so much water
it was basically just water. That wasn't good.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just tell me next time and I'll lend it to you!
...Honestly, good grief.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that ends today.
I'll settle this by buying in bulk!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Well then, single-stroke shopping... begins NOW!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Alright stop, stooop!
Don't climb the pillar!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
? To make the rounds efficiently, we should start with the upper floor shops.
From here, running up the pillars would be the shortest route.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I have a small request,
would it be alright if I accompanied her for shopping?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My intuition tells me that I cannot
let you go shopping all by yourself like this."
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah... I'm kind of worried anyway.
Y-Yeah... I'm kind of worried anyway.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Those shoes! Look at how straight the stitching is!
Oooohhh! Hold on, my wallet!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Don't just suddenly try to buy unplanned stuff!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"We have that hair oil in stock.
I'll go fetch it from the back right away~."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I know where it is.
It'll be faster if I go get it myself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's faster, it's still out of the question!
Just wait quietly!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Cats! Cats! A kitty paradise right here!
The El Dorado of my dreams is right before my eyes!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A cat café wasn't on our schedule, was it?!
We won't have time to visit all the shops at this rate!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I burned my mouth, so I'm going to cool it down.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That's what happens when you stuff your mouth
with piping hot food... Good grief.
choice_data_list: It's always so lively around Durandal, huh.
It's always so lively around Durandal, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"She's as noisy as a hundred people all by herself.
I just wish she'd settle down a bit."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: It's not like I can keep an eye on them twenty-four hours a day, either.
choice_data_list: You're such a caring friend, huh.
You're such a caring friend, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...She may indeed be my roommate and a dear friend,
but I am not being kind to her simply because she is my friend."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Help those in need without selfish calculation.
I believe that is the true, proper state of the heart."
choice_data_list: Maybe that's just what makes you, you.
Maybe that's just what makes you, you.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono...
choice_data_list: Please continue to be someone who reaches out a helping hand to others.
Please continue to be someone who reaches out a helping hand to others.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
――...Yes.
...Yes! Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Curse you, setting sun! I will return to the
academy faster than you can sink below the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hey, Light O-san! Your luggageーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It can't be helped, then.
I'll carry it back for you.
choice_data_list: You're the only one who can keep up with her.
You're the only one who can keep up with her.
On the flip side, you might find it unsatisfying if everything was peaceful and uneventful.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It can't be helped, then.
I'll carry it back for you.
choice_data_list: You're the only one who can keep up with her.
You're the only one who can keep up with her.
On the flip side, you might find it unsatisfying if everything was peaceful and uneventful.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly.
I can't tell if that's a good thing or not.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Still, well...
Curiously, it doesn't feel unpleasant."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Durandal laughing by my side,
I carried the heavy load as we headed home together.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I don't have such bizarre tastes or preferences!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Well... it certainly isn't boring, but
that's beside the point.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Come, Lord Trainer,
shall we go after Right O-san?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, we found an utterly exhausted Calstone Light O and returned to the academy together as a group of three.
